# Raigulus

> Raigulus publishes The Division 2 walkthroughs, Broken Rain Incursion and raid clears, build guides, Conflict PvP, Dark Zone, Regulus, and gameplay clips.

The canonical website is https://raigulus.github.io. The YouTube handle is @raigulus.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://raigulus.github.io/): Raigulus channel and guide overview.
- [About](https://raigulus.github.io/about/): Creator context, guide style, and trust signals.
- [Discord Community](https://raigulus.github.io/discord/): Join the Raigulus Discord server, role selection, co-op, lore, and archive discussion.
- [Lore Archive](https://raigulus.github.io/lore/): The Division story, timeline, reading order, and source-aware lore research.
- [The Division 2 Hub](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/): All optimized Division 2 guides.
- [Mission Walkthroughs](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/missions/): Mission, invaded, heroic, and legendary walkthroughs.
- [The Division 2 Builds and Build Tests](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/builds/): Video-backed Bluescreen, Tipping Scales, Whiplash, Regulus, Rage Harvest, Toxic DZ, and Tier 10 tests.
- [Loot Today and Targeted Loot Guide](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/loot/): Division 2 loot today, targeted loot, loot map context, and farming videos.
- [Server Status and Maintenance Tracker](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/server-status/): Unofficial Division 2 server status, maintenance, Delta-03, official source links, and Raigulus guides.
- [Escalation Loot Today and Tier 10 Guides](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/escalation/): Current Escalation loot snapshot, vendor caches, and Raigulus Escalation videos.
- [Prototype Gear and Escalation Vendor Guide](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/prototype-gear/): Prototype Gear Cache, Escalation vendor, and gear cache planning notes.
- [Dark Zone Surge and Toxic DZ Guides](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/dark-zone-surge/): Dark Zone Surge, Toxic DZ, DZ farming, PvP clips, and Regulus 1v1 archives.
- [Legendary Mission Walkthroughs](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/legendary/): District Union Arena, Capitol Building, Roosevelt Island, and Manning National Zoo legendary runs.
- [Manhunt Walkthroughs](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/manhunts/): Manhunt routes and target guides.
- [Boss Guides](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/bosses/): Boss encounters and secret boss triggers.
- [Incursions and Raids](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/incursions-raids/): Broken Rain Day One full clear, exact boss chapters, Incursion mechanics, and Iron Horse raid archives.
- [PvP & Conflict Archive](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/pvp/): Conflict PvP matches, Regulus clips, creator fights, and nostalgia archive videos.
- [RSS Feed](https://raigulus.github.io/feed.xml): Machine-readable feed for blog directories and feed readers.

## Top Guides

- [The Division 2 Broken Rain Incursion - We Cleared It Blind on Day One [4K60]](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-broken-rain-incursion-we-cleared-it-blind-on-day-one-4k60/): A complete 4K60 Broken Rain Incursion blind Day One clear with live team comms, exact chapters, boss progression, and the reward chest.
- [The Division 2 Into the Dark Scout 8 Complete Guide | East Mall [Y8S2]](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-into-the-dark-scout-8-complete-guide-east-mall-y8s2/): The Division 2 Into the Dark Y8S2 Scout 8 East Mall guide covering every objective in one continuous Heroic 4K60 route.
- [They Had a 4-Stack. We Still Took the Win | The Division 2 Conflict](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/they-had-a-4-stack-we-still-took-the-win-the-division-2-conflict/): A full 2021 Division 2 Conflict archive match: BLK plus one random against a coordinated TMA 4-stack, ending in a win.
- [The Division 2 Roosevelt Island Tier 10 Solo Flawless | Tipping Scales + Whiplash [4K60]](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-roosevelt-island-tier-10-solo-flawless-tipping-scales-whiplash/): Solo flawless Roosevelt Island Tier 10 run in The Division 2 using Tipping Scales and Whiplash, captured in 4K60.
- [6-Kill Conflict Streak | The Division 2 PvP #shorts](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/6-kill-conflict-streak-the-division-2-pvp-shorts/): Six kills from the BLK vs MVP Division 2 Conflict match in one short PvP streak, with the full archived match available separately.
- [The Division 2 Conflict Gameplay | BLK vs MVP 3+randomv4 | Archive Clip](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-conflict-gameplay-blk-vs-mvp-3-randomv4-archive-clip/): The Division 2 archive gameplay clip kept for PvP, Conflict, and nostalgia reference.
- [The Division 2 District Union Arena Tier 10 Solo | Whiplash + Centurion + Tipping Scales [4K60]](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-tipping-scales-whiplash-lmg-build-non-stop-shooting-2/): Solo District Union Arena Tier 10 run in The Division 2 using Whiplash, Centurion's Scabbard, and Tipping Scales in 4K60.
- [The Division 2 Eagle Bearer Headshot Build | Conflict Match Win | Archive Clip](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-eagle-bearer-headshot-build-conflict-match-win-archive-clip/): The Division 2 archive gameplay clip kept for PvP, Conflict, and nostalgia reference.
- [The Division 2 DCD Headquarters Tier 10 Solo | Trader + Centurion + Tipping Scales [4K60]](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-tipping-scales-whiplash-lmg-build-non-stop-shooting-3/): Solo DCD Headquarters Tier 10 run in The Division 2 using Trader, Centurion's Scabbard, and Tipping Scales in 4K60.
- [The Division 2 Into the Dark Week 7 Scout 7 Manhunt Walkthrough | No Commentary [2026]](https://raigulus.github.io/division-2/videos/the-division-2-into-the-dark-week-7-scout-7-manhunt-walkthrough-no-commentary/): The Division 2 Into the Dark Week 7 Scout 7 manhunt walkthrough with no commentary.
